jobs.description:
This Junior Administrative Assistant role offers the opportunity to support daily office operations, manage communication flows, and assist various departments with key administrative tasks. It's an ideal first job for someone eager to learn, grow, and develop strong organisational and professional skills in a dynamic environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well‑established and dynamic company located in Brussels. They offer a stimulating work environment where professionals can grow, develop new skills, and build a long‑term career. Due to continued expansion, they are looking for a motivated Administrative Assistant to join their team.

Description

As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting daily office operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
• Preparing and formatting documents, reports, and presentations
• Supporting various departments with administrative tasks
• Handling agendas, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments
• Ensuring proper filing and data management
• Assisting with internal communication and basic logistics
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient functioning of the office

• You are graduated in Administration, Office Management, Languages, Business, or equivalent
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Organized, detail‑oriented, and eager to take initiative
• Communicative, proactive, and capable of working in a fast‑paced environment
• Motivated to kickstart your career in administration and open to learning on the job

What will you do?

In this role, you combine headhunting top talent with actively building your own client portfolio. You will have the unique opportunity to write our success story in Zaventem right from the ground floor:

• 

Build Your Business: Proactively reach out to corporate clients across the region to map out their recruitment needs and develop long-lasting business partnerships.

• 

Find & Connect: Target and headhunt top talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, modern AI tools, and our existing network.

• 

Assess & Match: Conduct in-depth interviews to uncover candidates' career ambitions and match them with the right company culture.

• 

Drive Results: Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle from start to finish — from initial client acquisition to contract negotiation and candidate onboarding.

     
Who are you?

No prior recruitment background? That’s completely fine! We look for professionals with the right mindset and strong commercial instinct.

• 

Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (in any field).

• 

Language Skills: You are fluent in French and have a strong professional command of English. Good knowledge of Dutch is a clear advantage for our office dynamic.

• 

Commercial Drive: You are target-oriented, proactive on the phone, and motivated by tangible financial and professional growth.

• 

Profile: You combine sharp business acumen with high energy, resilience, and a drive to win.

• As an Automotive Technician, you play a crucial role in our production process.

• You are responsible for the assembly and installation of our products according to the highest quality standards. You will work in a modern and dynamic environment where teamwork is key.

• Through comprehensive training, you will become versatile and familiar with all different workstations within our production department. This not only provides variety in your work but also offers you the opportunity to continuously develop and enhance your technical skills.

• Flexibility: You are able to work in a rotating 2-shift system with working hours from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM.
• Independence and teamwork: You can work effectively both independently and in a team, contributing to a smooth and efficient production process.
• Experience: You have relevant experience in assembly work or in de automotive industry
• Accuracy and punctuality: You work meticulously and adhere strictly to procedures and deadlines, always striving for the highest quality.

• Communication skills: You have a good command of either Dutch or English, which is essential for smooth communication with colleagues and following instructions.
• Holiday planning: You are comfortable with collective leave, with 3 weeks off in the summer and 1 week between Christmas and New Year’s.

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. A solid technical understanding matters, but your impact will come through coaching, collaboration, and delivery rather than hands-on implementation.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Keep enough depth in our stack (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services) to contribute to architectural discussions and understand the challenges your team faces. Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

jobs.occupation: Junior Researcher on Multi-Agent Collaboration for Autonomous Ground Systems (iMUGS2) M/W/X
jobs.description:
PROJECT

You work within the Robotics & Autonomous Systems (https://mecatron.rma.ac.be/) research unit of the department of Mechanics of the Polytechnic Faculty of the RMA. You conduct scientific research at university level on a project entitled ¿iMUGS2¿.Your research will focus on the application of Multi-Agent Collaboration technology for collaborative autonomy in unmanned ground systems, including:

• Develop an interoperable, open, and modular multi-agent architecture in the global architecture of the project's System-of-Systems
• Study and integration of optimal multi-robot planning algorithms
• Define communication interface to enable the exchange of information between the team
 

Given the applied nature of this project and its strong involvement in European-scale collaborative defence programs, you will occasionally prepare and participate in on-site demonstrations and field trials, mainly on military sites in Europe.

 

MAIN TASKS

• Research/prototype multi-agent collaborative autonomy solutions for unmanned ground systems.
• Support development and implementation of standards that enable interoperability, focusing on mission management and multi-agent autonomy.
• Contribute to the integration with ROS/ROS2 of the developed solutions in real vehicles.
• Participate in testing, validation, and demonstration campaigns.
• Document your research and contribute to scientific publications, deliverables, and project reports. 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

Degree(s) required / ideal degree(s): Master/Engineer's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or related fields

This position is open for junior profiles (ideally 0-3 years of experience) or experienced profiles (up to 10 years of experience.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Excellent oral & written knowledge of English
• Experience in Robotics and knowledge in ROS/ROS2
• 
Good programming skills in Python and/or C++

 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills: 

• Experience in Multi-Agent Collaboration, or multimodal AI
• Knowledge in simulation environments for robotics
• Knowledge in robotics and/or software architecture design
• Knowledge in interoperability, standardisation and/or, more specifically, NATO STANAG/STANREC standards
• Experience in organising tests and demonstrations
• Minimum knowledge of French or Dutch is an added value for collaboration with peers.
Personal skills:

• Ability to work independently and in a multi-disciplinary, international team
• You will be working closely together with multiple industrial and academic partners and will get insight in their proprietary intellectual property. Confidentiality is therefore an absolute must.
• You are comfortable working in a complex international, multi-partner environment, fostering constructive collaboration, and resolving interpersonal tensions when needed.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher may be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defence.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European or NATO projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium for the duration of the study. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: From 15 November 2026, in consultation with the applicant. 
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours/week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• Please note that your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to the funding project, which is guaranteed until November 2028 (end of iMUGS2 project). There is a high chance for the project to be prolonged after this initial period, depending on the availability of new funding. 
• Wage scale: class NA11 (holder of a Master's degree in Science or equivalent), or NA21 (holder of an Ir degree or equivalent Master's in Engineering Sciences, doctor's degree in the same area of expertise), with valuable / relevant seniority.  A salary simulation can be done here: Simulateur de salaire. RMA applies a merit-based research career track, allowing researchers to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations.
• 
Holiday pay.

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a SELOR test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€ / day);
• Digital allowance: 15€ / month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days / week max);
• Holidays: 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years) & 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

Apicbase is a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to transform how the hospitality and food & beverage industry manages its operations. Our platform is trusted by the world's most ambitious restaurant groups, hotel chains, and foodservice operators and we're just getting started.
 

We're looking for a 
Strategic Account Manager who thrives in a high-growth environment, thinks commercially, works data-driven, and knows how to build lasting strategic partnerships with enterprise clients.
 

Your Role
 

You own a portfolio of key accounts and you take that ownership seriously. You're the strategic partner your clients didn't know they needed, and you make sure they always do.
 
 

•  

Embrace an agentic way of working: you leverage AI tools and automation to work smarter, move faster, and deliver more value to your clients and your team.
  

•  

Act as a trusted advisor not just a point of contact. You think ahead, flag challenges before they become issues, and bring solutions to the table.
  

•  

Retain and grow your client portfolio through proactive business reviews, health checks, and a sharp eye for risk and opportunity alike.
  

•  

Upsell and expand accounts by understanding your clients' strategic goals and connecting them to the full value of the Apicbase platform.
  

•  

Engage senior stakeholders across operations, finance, and C-level — you're comfortable holding strategic conversations at every level of an organization.
  

•  

Onboard and implement new enterprise clients with confidence, navigating complex setups and multi-stakeholder environments from day one.
  

•  

Drive adoption through data: you use platform insights, usage metrics, and KPIs to guide conversations and demonstrate ROI.
  

Your Profile
 
 

•  

Proven experience in account management, customer success, or a commercial role, ideally in SaaS, hospitality tech, or a B2B scale-up environment.
  

•  

Commercial mindset: you understand the full revenue cycle and know how to grow an account strategically, not just maintain it.
  

•  

Data-driven by nature: you're fluent in dashboards, KPIs, and business insights, and you use data to back every recommendation.
  

•  

Strong with complexity: large implementations &  multiple stakeholders - you don't shy away, you step up.
  

•  

Stakeholder management at its best: you build trust quickly, communicate with clarity, and know how to align different interests.
  

•  

Scale-up mentality: you're energized by change, comfortable with ambiguity, and thrive without a corporate playbook.
  

•  

Curious about technology:  AI, automation, agentic workflows: you're not just aware of these trends, you actively apply them.
  

•  

Native Dutch speaker with strong English skills. French is a definite plus.
  

•  

A team player at heart:  you enjoy being around driven, like-minded colleagues and thrive in an office environment (Antwerp) where energy, ideas, and ambition are contagious.
